delivery.q: How long does delivery take and how much does it cost?
delivery.a: We deliver to every governorate in Egypt. Delivery time and cost are shown for your governorate on the product page and in the cart.

cod.a: Yes, cash on delivery is available. You pay the courier in cash when your order arrives.

returns.q: What if I do not like the piece?
returns.a: The return window is {days} days from the delivery date. Details are on the returns page.

custom.q: Can I order a custom design?
custom.a: Our artisans accept custom requests. Message us on WhatsApp and tell us what you have in mind.

supportText: Reach us on WhatsApp and we will help you.
